reason: Gehazi (גֵּיחֲזִ֗י), identified as the servant of Elisha (נַעַר אֱלִישָׁע אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִים), is a named character who represents a more ordinary person compared to the other major figures in this narrative. While the other named characters include Naaman (a top military commander, שַׂר־ צְבָא) and Elisha (a renowned prophet and man of God), Gehazi is presented as a common servant-attendant with no independent authority or special status. He lacks the elevated position of commanders and prophets, making him the closest to what would be considered a 'regular person' among the named characters.
